name: Logger
description: Collect and display log events for orders
project_description: Logger records an audit history for Arch orders. It defines an 'arch_log' database table and an arch_logger service that writes a log row when an order is created or changed (capturing an old/new field diff in a serialized 'data' column) and when the cart is modified (add / change quantity / remove, captured by a kernel event subscriber and flushed to the order on checkout). Each order gains a Logs page (/order/{order}/log) and per-entry detail page, plus a 'History' entity operation, gated by the 'view order history' permission and per-order revision view access.
